note: Designer ruling 2026-08-23. BOUNTY_KILL_COUNTS.cull[1] = [80,120] is the board's EASY slot for a brand-new Bounty Hunter — ~100 fights before the first Mark exists, while the death sheet points at a Marks-priced trait. Ruling: 15-25 kills at Bounty-Hunter level 1, today's tier table from level 2. hr_accept_bounty__ungated does not GENERATE a contract, it CLAMPS the client's p_required into the tier range, so this moves the tier-1 FLOOR (80 -> 15) and deliberately leaves kmax at 120: lowering the ceiling would silently rewrite an honest 80-kill contract from a client whose BH level has already passed 1. The server cannot read a Bounty-Hunter level (BH xp lives in the save blob, not player_skills), so the grace is 'fewer than 3 bounty_turnin rows in the append-only player_ledger' — DERIVED (cheapest tier-1 cull xp 38, level-2 rung 83) and a deliberate SUPERSET of level 1, because a wider server range passes an honest required through unchanged while a narrower one rewrites it. Adds hr_bounty_first_contract_range + hr_bounty_first_contract (neither client-reachable) and a PARTIAL INDEX player_ledger_bounty_idx so the grace probe is not a ledger scan. Must run AFTER 2026-08-23-bounty.sql (restates hr_accept_bounty__ungated; precondition asserts it + hr_bounty_kill_range exist). Touches no graded body -> on no derivation chain; the rate-gated wrapper and its grants are untouched. Bound to src/core/bounty.js by tests/bounty-drift.mjs. NO edge redeploy — src/core/bounty.js is NOT in the hr-accrue import graph (verified by packing the function: 23 vendored core modules, bounty.js absent). Known limitation, stated in-file: hr_ledger_prune deletes rows older than 400 days, so a very old account can re-enter the grace for one tier-1 contract. Reversibility: re-apply 2026-08-23-bounty.sql §7.
